calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-26-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: P. Dias, CSR: Mitch Lyon.
Petitioner Sum Yeung Miu, present, in pro per, for minors, Sum Sheung Miu, Sum Yeung Miu and Sum Long Miu, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Names follows:
Sum Sheung Miu to Adriana Sum Miu
Sum Yeung Miu to Wilson Sum Miu
Sum Long Miu to Ronald Sum Miu
Decree signed in open court.

decreed_name: Adriana Sum Miu; Wilson Sum Miu; Ronald Sum Miu
